function.name: get_current_weather
function.description: Retrieves the current weather conditions for a specified location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which to get the weather, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA' or 'New York, NY'.

unit.description: The unit of temperature to be returned by the weather API.

function.name: add_postgres_server
function.description: Add or create a new Postgres server configuration to connect to a database. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

nickname.description: A unique nickname to identify the server configuration.

host.description: The hostname or IP address of the Postgres server, such as 'localhost' or '192.168.1.100'.

port.description: The port number on which the Postgres server is running. The default is the standard Postgres port.

database.description: The name of the database to connect to, typically 'postgres' for the default database.

username.description: The username for authenticating with the Postgres server, often 'postgres' by default.

password.description: The password associated with the username for authentication. Ensure this is kept secure.
